title: Thanksgiving, the printout
logline: Thursday. Thanksgiving at Gully's. The muffler-shop printout from Wednesday is already on the corkboard, pinned by Gully, above the register, beside the 2003 rough. Wood, small, eats around it.

panels.composition: Gully's, closed for the holiday, a turkey on the bait counter, two plates. GULLY carving. WOOD, small, on the stool. BARNABY under it with a leg already.
props: a turkey on the bait counter

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a closed bait shop on Thanksgiving with a roast turkey on the counter, a man in an apron carving, a small thin man on the end stool and a dog beneath with a drumstick

panels.composition: The corkboard above the register: the 2003 pencil rough, and beside it, new, a printout — the stick figure, a Boise nephew's inkjet. Pinned with a fishing hook.
props: the printout, pinned with a hook

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, close-up of a corkboard above a shop register with a pencil sketch of a man on a ladder and beside it a fresh inkjet printout of a crude stick figure pinned with a fishing hook
image.notes: Gully's corkboard inventory: the muffler-shop printout, Nov 2006, pinned with a hook (objects.md).

panels.composition: Wood, small, looking up at it. Gully, not looking at him.

balloons.text: It's the reason I've got. Eat.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a small thin man looking up at a corkboard while a man in an apron avoids looking at him

panels.composition: The two of them eating. The dog. The printout above them. The pencil rough beside it. The corkboard doesn't rank things.
